full.description: This is a micrograph showing a section of brain tissue stained with hematoxylin and eosin. The histological section displays perivascular cuffing and inflammatory cell infiltration, characteristic of viral encephalitis or a similar central nervous system infection. Microglial nodules and mononuclear inflammatory cells are visible scattered throughout the parenchyma near a blood vessel. These findings strongly suggest an infectious or inflammatory process affecting the brain tissue.

random.description: This image is a photomicrograph of brain tissue showing histopathological changes. A focal collection of inflammatory cells, predominantly lymphocytes and microglial cells forming a glial nodule, is visible within the parenchyma. Additionally, there is perivascular cuffing and localized hemorrhage near a blood vessel. These findings are characteristic of viral encephalitis, such as rabies or another arboviral infection.
